name: Lektrine the Storm Witch
bio: From her grand meteorological tower, the Thunderbolt Steeple, Lektrine protects much of Amara from turbulent weather. She's quelled tornados that could have levelled the Academy, and redirected hurricanes that would have smashed the entire Free Armada to pieces. But there's one dark cloud on the horizon that even she can't quell...
